notes: «- المعنى -» is an editor's gloss and «قال أبو داود وأنا لحديثه، أتقن» is the compiler's remark; both left out
«قالا حدثنا» joins the two co-transmitters into one level, so there is one route, not two branches
«مولى تجيب» describes Abu Marzuq and is not part of the name
The Prophet is the end; Ruwayfi' is the last link
